description:
Sydney was on a college club trip to a rural village when a mysterious power transformed him into a woman. Determined to turn back, he soon finds himself helplessly addicted to the overwhelming pleasure of his new female body.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Slutification), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/amkeot_tarak), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/female_depravity?p_id=pp_1601_001) 

**Official Translations:**    
[Japanese](https://www.toptoon.jp/product/116961) 

*Note: First released on DayComics (English version of Toptoon) from September to October 2025. It was later removed due to the author's request.*
